s-1.ptxt: Inspect Tie Rod End Sub-assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Secure the ball joint of the tie rod end LH in a vise using aluminum plates.
Install the castle nut to the stud bolt.
Turn the ball joint back and forth 5 times or more.
Set a torque wrench on the nut, turn the ball joint continuously at a rate of 1 turn per 3-5 seconds, and check the turning torque on the 5 turn.

atten4.ptxt: If the result is not as specified, replace the tie rod end LH with a new one.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Tie Rod End Sub-assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, inspect the total preload of the steering gear assembly.

atten4.ptxt: If the result is not as specified, replace the steering gear assembly with a new one.
